[[BC Lietuvos Rytas|Lietuvos Rytas]] (2010-present) | awards = * [[List of LKL champions|LKL Champion]] (2010) * [[Lithuanian Basketball Federation|LKF Cup Winner]] (2010) * 2x [[LKL All-Star Game|LKL All-Star]] ([[2010 LKL All-Star Game|2010]], [[2011 LKL All-Star Game|2011]]) * [[LKL All-Star Game Most Valuable Player Award|LKL All-Star Game MVP]] ([[2011 LKL All-Star Game|2011]]) * [[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]] [[MVP]] ([[2008 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|2008]]) * [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] [[MVP]] ([[U18 European Championship Men 2010 Division A|2010]]) }} '''Jonas Valančiūnas''' (born 6 May 1992) is a [[Lithuania|Lithuanian]] professional basketball player, currently playing for [[BC Lietuvos Rytas|Lietuvos Rytas]] in the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]], the [[Euroleague]], the [[Baltic Basketball League]], and the [[VTB United League]]. He is considered as a top pick in the [[2011 NBA Draft]]. ==Basketball playing career== ===Early career (2008-present)=== Valančiūnas started playing professionally for [[BC Perlas|Perlas]] in 2008 and played there until December 2009. During the 2008-09 season the team played in the [[Lithuania|Lithuanian]] [[National Basketball League (Lithuania)|National Basketball League]] (NKL), Lithuania's second strongest league, but moved up to the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL) the following season. Valančiūnas played in the first half of the 2009-10 season with Perlas, but on 17 January 2010, he signed a contract with Lithuanian powerhouse [[BC Lietuvos Rytas|Lietuvos Rytas]]. While playing for Lietuvos Rytas, Valančiūnas has participated in two [[LKL All-Star Game|LKL All-Star Games]], the [[2010 LKL All-Star Game|2010]] and [[2011 LKL All-Star Game|2011 All-Star Games]]. During the 2011 All-Star Game Valančiūnas scored 18 points and grabed 10 rebounds, helping the "Lithuanians" win the game. He was named as the [[LKL All-Star Game Most Valuable Player Award|2011 LKL All-Star Game MVP]]. Outside of the entertainment events, Valančiūnas has led Lietuvos Rytas to the [[LKL Finals]] twice, in 2010 and 2011. The team won the 2010 series against [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris]] 4-3, but lost the following year 1-4. In 2010, Lietuvos Rytas also won the [[Lithuanian Basketball Federation]] (LKF) Cup. He is considered a top prospect at the [[2011 NBA Draft]]. ==International career== {{MedalTableTop}} {{MedalCountry|{{LTU}}}} {{MedalSport | Men's [[Basketball]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold| [[U18 European Championship Men 2010 Division A|2010 Lithuania]] | [[U18 European Championship Men 2010 Division A|Team competition]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold| [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|2008 Italy]] | [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|Team competition]]}} {{MedalBottom}} Valančiūnas made his debut for the [[Lithuania national basketball team|Lithuanian national basketball team]] in the [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]] in Italy. He dominated throughout the tournament, averaging 14.3 points, 11.1 rebounds, and 2.3 blocks in 23.5 minutes of action. His team went on to win the gold medal and he was chosen as the [[MVP]]. Two years later, Valančiūnas led Lithuania to another gold medal. Lithuania dominated in the [[U18 European Championship Men 2010 Division A|2010 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] held in [[Lithuania]]. Valančiūnas averaged 19.4 points, 13.4 rebounds and 2.7 blocks, and was voted as the [[MVP]].
